data.body: **[P2] Preserve registration-order startup context.** Constructing every plugin before invoking any start hook prevents an earlier plugin from installing thread-local or OpenTelemetry context for a later plugin. Both OTel factories now read `Span.current()`, extract context, and start the invocation span during construction, so the resulting span can have the wrong parent or sampling decision. Interleave each factory with its start hook, or defer OTel's context-sensitive initialization to `onInvocationStart`; cover an initializer plugin registered before OTel.
